name: World and building
description: Placement helpers: fill holes and liquids, and build from templates. Every placement goes through the silent placement pipeline.

addons.HoleFiller: Fills holes in the floor within two blocks of you, with blocks from the hotbar.
addons.LiquidFiller: Places blocks into the water or lava around you, so you can walk and bridge across it.
addons.AutoExtinguish: Puts out fire by pouring water at your feet, aimed on the silent rotation.
